(3) The main character, a young woman with long dark hair, is seen wearing the bracelet while sitting in a prayer-like meditative pose as warm sunlight streams across her face. (4) The scene shifts to the woman performing daily chores like vacuuming a sunlit living room and then practicing advanced yoga, specifically a crow pose transitioning into a headstand. (5) In a lush green park, she is seen meditatively adjusting her hair and practicing eagle-arm yoga poses on a mat on the grass. (6) The woman is then shown driving a car with a red leather interior, her hand on the steering wheel clearly displaying the crystal bracelet.
